data.one_liner: Parses PDF-417 barcodes on US and Canadian driver's licenses
data.what_it_does: Provides a utility to parse information from PDF-417 barcodes found on the back of driver's licenses in the US and Canada. It supports AAMVA Version 8 as well as older standards.
use_when: You need to parse driver's license barcode data in US or Canadian formats
You are processing AAMVA-compliant license standards
avoid_when: You need a built-in barcode scanner camera utility to capture the barcode
strengths: Supports multiple AAMVA versions including Version 8 and older standards
Extracts comprehensive fields like name, date of birth, address, and physical characteristics
weaknesses: Does not provide a camera scanning utility to acquire the barcode data itself
